lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: Five firms are pooling their models this year. Ours is the one with a conscience, which is why I am up a mountain offering a monastery a stipend instead of buying the valley outright.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: You people are not on my manifest and I have stopped caring. Talk to Kell. She is the one stalling.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: A pleasure doing business with a house that understands risk.
